purpose: Incremental official-source evidence for the existing full affiliate audit. Evidence only; this does not create a new queue task or UUID. The current main-branch COSHUMA tool dataset and latest queue state were checked first; none of these five tools currently has a dedicated application task in latest.json.

entries.network: FirstPromoter on the current affiliate page; an older March 2026 help article still references Impact, so the first-party network discrepancy is preserved
entries.commission: Current affiliate page and affiliate terms state 30% commission for the first two paid months, then 15% recurring while the referred subscriber remains active and the program remains active
entries.payout_terms: Current affiliate terms say approved commissions are paid on a regular monthly cadence after a 30-90 day processing/fraud-review window; payout method is whatever Blaze supports in the affiliate dashboard. A March 2026 help article separately states Net-30 and a $20 threshold, but because current first-party pages differ, those older details are not treated as controlling.
entries.eligibility: Current page targets entrepreneurs, newsletters, educators, media networks, content creators, influencers and bloggers with an existing engaged audience. Applications are reviewed and may be declined; paid-media-heavy and coupon/deal-aggregation models are disfavored. Self-referrals are prohibited.
entries.evidence_summary: Blaze currently has a live affiliate application path. Current first-party materials confirm 30% for the first two paid months followed by 15% recurring. First-party pages conflict on tracking/network details (current page shows FirstPromoter and a 30-day trial-attribution flow; older help material shows Impact and a 60-day cookie), so the audit preserves the conflict instead of inventing one cookie value.

entries.commission: Monthly plans: 80% of the first month, then 30% lifetime recurring. Yearly plans: 40% of the first year, then 30% recurring on later renewals. One-time products: $25 flat commission.
entries.payout_terms: Current official page does not publicly state payout threshold, payout method or payout timing; those values remain unknown.
entries.eligibility: Current official page says signup takes under 60 seconds with no approval wait. It promotes use by video creators, social-media publishers, bloggers and direct referrers; no South Korea exclusion is shown on the retrieved public page.
entries.evidence_summary: AiAssistWorks' current official affiliate page confirms an active no-approval-wait signup path, up to 80% initial commission, 30% lifetime recurring revenue on subscriptions after the initial bonus period, and free signup.

entries.commission: 50% of referred subscription payments for up to 12 months; no payout cap
entries.payout_terms: The current official partner page demonstrates recurring payout examples and says there is no payout cap, but does not publicly state payout method, payout schedule or minimum threshold; those values remain unknown.
entries.eligibility: The current public partner page invites users to join and start earning in about 60 seconds and does not state a geographic exclusion. Tax reporting is the affiliate's responsibility.
entries.evidence_summary: Questmate's current official partner page confirms a live Rewardful signup path and 50% recurring revenue share on each referred subscription for up to 12 months, with no payout cap.

entries.commission: 30% recurring commission for eligible paid conversions; current official headline also advertises earnings up to $67 per sale
entries.payout_terms: Paid around the first working week of each month; $100 minimum payout threshold. Exact payout method is configured in the affiliate partner account and is not specified on the retrieved public page.
entries.eligibility: A paid Merlin subscription is not required to join. Monthly referrals must meet a EUR 14 minimum order value and annual referrals a USD 100 minimum order value unless a special affiliate coupon/offer overrides that rule. Self-referrals are prohibited and paid ads require special permission.
entries.evidence_summary: Merlin's current official affiliate page confirms a live Tapfiliate signup path, 30% recurring commission, a 90-day cookie, monthly payout cadence, a $100 payout threshold and no requirement to buy a paid Merlin subscription.

entries.commission: 50% commission on qualifying sales; the signup portal describes the commission as recurring
entries.payout_terms: Paid monthly via PayPal, approximately 30 days after month-end; no earnings cap
entries.eligibility: Official page says the program is open worldwide with no location restrictions. PPC campaigns require prior approval; a 14-day refund policy applies to qualifying commissions.
entries.evidence_summary: Decktopus' current official affiliate page confirms a live signup path, 50% commission, 60-day cookie, free worldwide eligibility and monthly PayPal payouts.
